language.label: Preferred language
language.description:
Preferred language for metadata.

This language is also used as the fallback locale for text-based searches, so localized item names (e.g. genres and built-in playlists) can be found by the name shown in this language.

Note that English will always be used as fallback when content in your preferred language is not available.

enable_online_metadata.label: Enable metadata retrieval from online metadata providers
enable_online_metadata.description:
Enable online metadata lookups.

This will allow Music Assistant to fetch additional metadata from (enabled) metadata providers, such as The Audio DB and Fanart.tv.

Note that these online sources are only queried when no information is already available from local files or the music providers and local artwork/metadata will always have preference over online sources so consider metadata from online sources as complementary only.

The retrieval of additional rich metadata is a process that is executed slowly in the background to not overload these free services with requests. You can speedup the process by storing the images and other metadata locally.

link_providers_via_musicbrainz.label: Link items to your other music services through MusicBrainz
link_providers_via_musicbrainz.description:
Use the links MusicBrainz keeps to find the artists, albums and tracks of your library on your other music services, instead of searching each service for them.

When enabled, a background task works through your library in small batches, right after a library sync and once every hour, and items are also linked whenever their metadata is refreshed. Identifying items on MusicBrainz itself still happens on every metadata refresh, as the other metadata providers rely on it, so items refreshed while this was disabled are linked at their next metadata refresh.

prefer_local_genres.label: Use local genre metadata only when available
prefer_local_genres.description: When enabled, online metadata providers will not add genres to items that already have a genre from a local source such as a file tag or NFO file. Items with no local genre still receive genres from online providers as usual.

enable_radio_metadata_lookup.label: Enable artist/track artwork lookup for radio streams
enable_radio_metadata_lookup.description:
Look up artist and track artwork for radio streams from online sources when the station provides Artist - Track metadata.

When disabled, radio streams show only the station logo (when available).

thumb_cache_max_size.label: Maximum thumbnail cache size (MB)
thumb_cache_max_size.description:
Maximum total size in megabytes for the on-disk thumbnail cache.

Oldest thumbnails are automatically removed when this limit is exceeded.
